title: fleet-import
description: Creates clients and sites in bulk (finding F6.R4): one row per site, naming its client. A client or site that already exists is used as it is, so the same list can be imported again. Previewed without a code; imported by an Admin with an authenticator code bound to these rows. Cabinets are not imported: a cabinet exists only once it enrols (a site installer and batch approval make that a bulk action).

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action and these rows. Required to import; not sent for a preview.
